description.ja: 全てのプラモデル未経験者に贈る入門用シリーズ「ENTRY GRADE」にカービィが登場！
description.en: Kirby appears in the introductory series "ENTRY GRADE" given to all plastic model inexperienced people!

description.ja: ■顔の色分けパーツはマキシムトマトやおにぎりパーツなどで再現！カービィが食べ物をすいこんだイメージで組み立てられる「まんぷくビルド」が楽しい！
description.en: • Color-coded face parts are reproduced with Maxim tomato and rice ball parts! It's fun to assemble "Manpuku Build" with the image of Kirby swallowing food!

description.ja: ■タッチゲートだからパーツは手で"プチッ！"と取れる。
description.en: • Since it is a touch gate, parts can be removed by hand.

description.ja: ■接着剤や工具は不要。説明書は見やすい色付き。
description.en: • No glue or tools required. The manual is colored for easy viewing.

description.ja: ■少ないパーツ数なので、プラモデルを初めてつくる方でもサクサクと組み立てが可能。
description.en: • Since the number of parts is small, even those who are making plastic models for the first time can easily assemble it.

description.ja: ■ワープスター型の台座が付属。
description.en: • A warp star-shaped pedestal is included.
